theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 13 群

items.pos: n. 缺乏 | v. 缺少
items.colloc: lack of experience 缺乏經驗 | suffer from a lack of 遭受…的缺乏
items.distinct: shortage 短缺（數量不足）| absence 缺席；不存在
ex: The team failed due to a lack of preparation.
團隊因缺乏準備而失敗。
We lack the resources to finish this project.
我們缺少完成此專案的資源。
His proposal was rejected for lack of detail.
他的提議因缺乏細節而被拒絕。

items.colloc: limited budget 有限的預算 | limited time 有限的時間
items.distinct: restricted 受限制的 | finite 有限的（數學或哲學概念）
ex: We have limited time to reach a decision.
我們做決定的時間有限。
The company offers limited benefits for interns.
公司為實習生提供的福利有限。
Our budget is too limited for this expansion.
我們的預算對此次擴張來說太有限了。

items.pos: n. 措施；測量 | v. 測量
items.colloc: take measures 採取措施 | safety measure 安全措施
items.distinct: step 步驟；手段 | gauge 測量；計量器
ex: The government took measures to boost the economy.
政府採取了措施來促進經濟。
Please measure the dimensions of the package.
請測量包裹的尺寸。
Strict measures were implemented to ensure safety.
為確保安全執行了嚴格措施。

items.colloc: missing document 遺失的文件 | missing item 缺少項目
items.distinct: lost 迷路的；弄丟的 | absent 缺席的
ex: There is a missing page in the contract.
合約中遺失了一頁。
The accountant found some missing receipts today.
會計今天發現了一些缺失的收據。
Several files are missing from the shared folder.
共享資料夾中少了幾份檔案。

items.colloc: not necessarily 未必 | necessarily follow 必然結果
items.distinct: inevitably 不可避免地 | automatically 自動地
ex: Higher price does not necessarily mean better quality.
價格較高未必代表品質較好。
It is not necessarily the best solution available.
這未必是目前最好的解決方案。
Does this result necessarily imply a profit drop?
這個結果必然意味著利潤下滑嗎？

items.colloc: observe the rules 遵守規則 | observe the market 觀察市場
items.distinct: follow 跟隨；遵循 | monitor 監控；監督
ex: All employees must observe company regulations.
所有員工都必須遵守公司規定。
We will observe consumer behavior during the sale.
我們將觀察特賣會期間的消費者行為。
She observed a significant shift in the industry.
她觀察到產業有重大轉變。

items.pos: n. 提議；報價 | v. 提供
items.colloc: job offer 工作錄取通知 | make an offer 出價
items.distinct: provide 提供（供給）| suggest 建議
ex: The manager offered her a new position.
經理向她提供了一個新職位。
We received an excellent offer from the supplier.
我們收到供應商極佳的報價。
This software offers a variety of advanced features.
這套軟體提供了多種進階功能。

items.colloc: officially opened 正式開幕 | officially announced 正式宣布
items.distinct: formally 禮貌地；正式地 | publicly 公開地
ex: The merger was officially announced this morning.
合併案於今早正式宣布。
Our new branch office is now officially open.
我們的新分公司現已正式開幕。
They were officially recognized for their achievements.
他們的成就得到了官方認可。

items.colloc: outstanding performance 傑出表現 | outstanding balance 未結清餘額
items.distinct: excellent 優良的 | unpaid 未支付的
ex: She received an award for outstanding service.
她因傑出的服務獲得了獎項。
We need to pay the outstanding balance soon.
我們需要儘快支付未結清的餘額。
His outstanding work helped the team succeed.
他傑出的表現協助團隊獲得成功。

items.colloc: in particular 特別是 | particular attention 特別注意
items.distinct: specific 明確的 | peculiar 獨特的；古怪的
ex: Is there any particular reason for the delay?
延遲有任何特定的原因嗎？
Pay particular attention to the safety guidelines.
請特別注意安全準則。
The client is very particular about the design.
客戶對設計非常挑剔。

items.colloc: permanent job 長期工作 | permanent address 固定地址
items.distinct: temporary 暫時的 | lasting 持久的
ex: She is looking for a permanent position.
她正在尋找長期職位。
The company will establish a permanent office there.
公司將在那裡設立常設辦公室。
This damage may have a permanent effect.
這種損害可能會造成永久性影響。

items.colloc: permanently closed 永久關閉 | permanently damaged 永久損壞
items.distinct: constantly 不斷地 | indefinitely 無期限地
ex: The store has been permanently closed since June.
該店自六月起已永久關閉。
The file was permanently deleted from the system.
檔案已從系統中永久刪除。
We plan to relocate permanently to the city.
我們計畫永久搬遷到這座城市。

items.colloc: prior notice 事先通知 | prior experience 先前經驗
items.distinct: previous 先前的 | preceding 在先的
ex: Prior notice is required for all cancellations.
所有取消皆須事先通知。
Do you have any prior experience in sales?
你有任何先前的銷售經驗嗎？
We need to finalize the plan prior to meeting.
我們需要在會議前定案此計畫。

items.colloc: processing time 處理時間 | data processing 資料處理
items.distinct: handling 處理（應對）| management 管理
ex: The order processing will take three days.
訂單處理需要三天時間。
We are upgrading our data processing system.
我們正在升級資料處理系統。
Food processing requires strict hygiene standards.
食品加工需要嚴格的衛生標準。

items.colloc: new product 新產品 | product launch 產品發表
items.distinct: production 生產 | commodity 商品
ex: We are launching a new product next month.
我們下個月要推出一項新產品。
This product is designed for professional use.
這項產品是為專業用途所設計。
The company’s latest product was a big success.
該公司最新的產品非常成功。

items.colloc: production line 生產線 | mass production 大量生產
items.distinct: product 產品 | manufacture 製造
ex: The factory has increased its production capacity.
工廠已經增加了生產產能。
They halted production due to machine failure.
由於機器故障，他們暫停了生產。
Efficient production is key to our profitability.
有效率的生產是我們獲利的關鍵。

items.colloc: recently completed 最近完成 | recently joined 最近加入
items.distinct: lately 最近 | nowadays 現今
ex: I recently joined the marketing department team.
我最近加入了行銷部門團隊。
They recently completed the renovation project.
他們最近完成了翻新專案。
Have you seen the recently published report?
你看過最近出版的報告了嗎？

items.colloc: highly recommend 強烈推薦 | recommend a candidate 推薦候選人
items.distinct: suggest 建議 | advise 勸告
ex: I highly recommend this training workshop to you.
我強烈推薦這個培訓工作坊給你。
The consultant recommended a new strategy.
顧問建議了一項新策略。
Can you recommend a reliable software vendor?
你能推薦可靠的軟體供應商嗎？

items.colloc: reject an application 拒絕申請 | reject a proposal 駁回提議
items.distinct: refuse 拒絕（要求）| decline 婉拒（邀請或提議）
ex: The committee decided to reject his proposal.
委員會決定駁回他的提議。
We had to reject several defective items.
我們不得不拒收幾項瑕疵品。
The bank rejected our loan application today.
銀行今天拒絕了我們的貸款申請。

items.colloc: relatively stable 相對穩定 | relatively high 相對較高
items.distinct: comparatively 相較之下 | fairly 相當地
ex: The project is relatively simple to complete.
這個專案完成起來相對簡單。
Our company remained relatively stable during recession.
我們公司在經濟衰退期間維持相對穩定。
The price is relatively low for this quality.
以這種品質來說，價格相對較低。
